ASSISTANT: I can help with that. What's your policy number?
USER: TRP-2024-5578
ASSISTANT: I see this was for a Europe trip in May?
USER: Yes, two week Mediterranean cruise
ASSISTANT: What was the cancellation reason?
USER: Medical emergency
ASSISTANT: Your medical emergency or family member?
USER: Mine, I had a cardiac event
ASSISTANT: I'm sorry to hear that. Are you okay now?
USER: Getting better, still recovering
ASSISTANT: When did the medical event occur?
USER: April 28th
ASSISTANT: And your trip was scheduled for May 5th?
USER: Yes, departing May 5th
ASSISTANT: So one week before departure
USER: Exactly
ASSISTANT: Do you have medical documentation?
USER: I have the hospital discharge papers
ASSISTANT: We'll need the admission records too
USER: I can get those
ASSISTANT: Also physician's statement that travel was inadvisable
USER: My cardiologist wrote something
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Now, about pre-existing conditions
USER: What about them?
ASSISTANT: When did you purchase this policy?
USER: In January when I booked the cruise
ASSISTANT: Any heart issues before January?
USER: I've been seeing a cardiologist
ASSISTANT: For how long?
USER: Since November
ASSISTANT: That could be considered pre-existing
USER: But I didn't have a heart attack then
ASSISTANT: Were you being treated for any cardiac condition?
USER: Just monitoring, no real diagnosis
ASSISTANT: What prompted the cardiologist visit?
USER: Chest pain during exercise
ASSISTANT: At a gym?
USER: Yes, that's when it started
ASSISTANT: Did you file any other insurance claims?
USER: Like what?
ASSISTANT: Health insurance, gym insurance, anything
USER: Just my regular health insurance
ASSISTANT: No accident claims?
USER: It wasn't an accident
ASSISTANT: Sometimes cardiac events during exercise are covered
USER: I didn't know that
ASSISTANT: Check with your gym
USER: I actually cancelled my membership
ASSISTANT: When?
USER: Been meaning to for months
ASSISTANT: But still active?
USER: I think so, they keep charging me
ASSISTANT: Might have coverage you don't know about
USER: I'll check
ASSISTANT: Now, back to the trip claim
USER: Yes?
ASSISTANT: Total trip cost was $12,000?
USER: For me and my wife
ASSISTANT: Is she claiming too?
USER: She didn't go either
ASSISTANT: Because of your condition?
USER: Yes, she stayed with me
ASSISTANT: Her cancellation is covered as traveling companion
USER: Oh good
ASSISTANT: Did you purchase Cancel for Any Reason coverage?
USER: I don't think so
ASSISTANT: No, you have standard coverage
USER: What's the difference?
ASSISTANT: Standard requires covered reason like medical
USER: Which I have
ASSISTANT: Yes, if not pre-existing
USER: How do you determine that?
ASSISTANT: Medical records review
USER: What are you looking for?
ASSISTANT: Treatment, medications, tests in 180 days prior
USER: I had some tests
ASSISTANT: What kind?
USER: EKG, stress test
ASSISTANT: Results?
USER: Showed some irregularities
ASSISTANT: That might be an issue
USER: Even though nothing happened then?
ASSISTANT: Indicates pre-existing condition
USER: So my claim will be denied?
ASSISTANT: Not necessarily
USER: What would help?
ASSISTANT: Doctor stating this was unexpected acute event
USER: Despite the previous tests?
ASSISTANT: If sudden and unexpected, might qualify
USER: My doctor said it was a surprise
ASSISTANT: Get that in writing
USER: Okay
ASSISTANT: Also, did you have travel insurance before?
USER: On other trips?
ASSISTANT: Yes
USER: A few times
ASSISTANT: Any previous claims?
USER: One, for lost luggage
ASSISTANT: That's fine
USER: Why does it matter?
ASSISTANT: Pattern of claims can affect coverage
USER: I see
ASSISTANT: Did your wife have any medical issues?
USER: No, she's healthy
ASSISTANT: Her portion should be straightforward
USER: At least half might be covered?
ASSISTANT: Potentially
USER: What about the cruise line?
ASSISTANT: Did they offer any credit?
USER: Future cruise credit only
ASSISTANT: How much?
USER: 75% of value
ASSISTANT: When does it expire?
USER: One year
ASSISTANT: Can you use it?
USER: Not sure I can travel
ASSISTANT: Medically?
USER: Doctor says maybe next year
ASSISTANT: Get that documented too
USER: For the claim?
ASSISTANT: Shows ongoing impact
USER: Good point
ASSISTANT: What about your return to work?
USER: I'm self-employed
ASSISTANT: Lost income from the cardiac event?
USER: Yes, couldn't work for weeks
ASSISTANT: Document that too
USER: Why?
ASSISTANT: Strengthens medical severity
USER: Makes sense
ASSISTANT: Submit everything together
USER: When will I know?
ASSISTANT: Review takes 15-30 days
USER: That long?
ASSISTANT: Medical claims require thorough review
USER: I understand
ASSISTANT: Keep all original documents
USER: Will do
ASSISTANT: We'll email you updates
USER: Thanks for your help
ASSISTANT: Feel better soon
